blind.description: A medieval training pell (sword-striking post) made of stylized timber. It features a square timber base frame supported by four diagonal braces leading to a thick central vertical post. The post is tightly bound around its middle with thick rope wrapping; directly above the rope, the wood is heavily hacked and splintered from weapon strikes, exposing lighter raw wood. Textures are stylized hand-painted wood and hemp rope, fully continuous with no floating, melted, or broken fragments.
blind.from_above: A square wooden frame with four braces meeting at a central circular post top displaying stylized growth rings and a perimeter of jagged, light-tan hacked wood splinters.
blind.height_vs_figure: Stands roughly two-thirds the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (about 3.5 to 4 ft tall) with a base roughly 2.5 to 3 ft wide on each side.
